title: MM-Spectrum: Multimodal Multi-spectral Molecular Structural Elucidation with a Stable MoE Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.27286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inferring molecular structures from multimodal spectroscopic measurements requires integrating complementary yet highly heterogeneous signals. However, the common paradigm of directly concatenating multispectral sequences can exhibit anomalous performance degradation, primarily due to pronounced heterogeneity and the resulting multimodal imbalance across modalities. As a remedy, we propose MM-Spectrum, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework tailored for multimodal multispectral spectra-to-structure elucidation. To better match the information characteristics under multispectral imbalance, MM-Spectrum introduces an explicit modality-aware routing mechanism that exposes spectral identity to the router in addition to token content representations. translated_title: MM-Spectrum：基于稳定MoE框架的多模态多光谱分子结构解析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27286v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：从多模态光谱测量中推断分子结构需要整合互补但高度异质的信号。然而，直接拼接多光谱序列的常见范式会出现异常性能下降，主要原因是跨模态的显著异质性和由此产生的多模态不平衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MM-Spectrum，一个专为多模态多光谱谱图到结构解析设计的稀疏专家混合框架。为了更好地匹配多光谱不平衡下的信息特征，MM-Spectrum引入了一种显式的模态感知路由机制，该机制除了令牌内容表示外，还将光谱身份暴露给路由器。此外，它整合了共享专家和交互专家，以及异构专家容量，以提取多光谱模态特有信息和跨模态协同信息，同时抑制干扰。
tldr: 该论文提出MM-Spectrum框架，通过显式模态感知路由和共享/交互专家机制，有效解决多模态光谱数据异质性导致的不平衡问题，提升分子结构解析准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MM-Spectrum, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework that addresses multimodal imbalance via explicit modality-aware routing and shared/interaction experts, improving molecular structure elucidation from multispectral data.
